**Delivery Manager | Engineering, AI & Data – Engineering | AI Data Center Infrastructure**

  

**Location: Delhi**

  

**The team**

Engineering helps empower and drive mission-critical solutions whether we need to modernize existing systems or implement new technology products and platforms. Through innovation, we improve financial performance, accelerate new digital businesses and fuel growth. Learn more about Engineering, AI and Data

  

**Your work profile**

The AI Data Center Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the operational management, monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and optimization of AI-ready data center infrastructure supporting high-density GPU, HPC, and AI workloads. The role ensures continuous availability of power, cooling, networking, rack infrastructure, and facility systems while maintaining operational excellence, compliance, and service-level commitments.

The engineer works closely with facility operations, IT infrastructure, cloud, network, AI platform, and vendor teams to ensure stable and efficient operation of mission-critical AI infrastructure.

Infrastructure Operations

* Monitor and operate critical data center infrastructure including electrical, mechanical, and IT support systems.
* Ensure availability and reliability of power, cooling, network, and server room environments.
* Manage day-to-day operational activities across AI infrastructure facilities.
* Support continuous operations in a 24x7 mission-critical environment.

AI Infrastructure Support

* Support AI clusters, GPU servers, HPC systems, and storage platforms.
* Monitor GPU utilization, thermal performance, power consumption, and environmental conditions.
* Coordinate with AI engineering teams during deployment, upgrade, and operational activities.
* Support infrastructure readiness for AI workload scaling and expansion.

Power Systems Management

* Operate and monitor: Utility power systems, Switchgear, Transformers, UPS systems, Battery systems, PDUs, Standby generators
* Ensure power redundancy and resilience are maintained.
* Participate in maintenance and testing activities.

Cooling Systems Operations

* Monitor and operate cooling infrastructure including: Chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, In-row cooling systems, Rear-door heat exchangers, Liquid cooling systems
* Environmental monitoring platforms, Support high-density AI rack cooling requirements. Optimize thermal management and cooling efficiency.

Monitoring and Incident Management

* Monitor alarms through DCIM, BMS, EMS, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Respond to infrastructure incidents and service disruptions.
* Perform troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA).
* Coordinate incident response and recovery activities.

Capacity and Performance Management

* Monitor capacity utilization for: Power, Cooling, Rack space, Network connectivity
* Develop forecasts and operational reports.
* Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and growth requirements.

Reliability and Maintenance

* Execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
* Develop and maintain operational procedures and runbooks.
* Review maintenance activities to minimize operational risks.
* Support reliability improvement initiatives.

Change Management

* Review infrastructure changes and maintenance requests.
* Develop and execute: MOP (Method of Procedure), SOP (Standard Operating Procedure), EOP (Emergency Operating Procedure)
* Conduct risk assessments for planned activities.

Compliance and Governance

* Maintain compliance with industry standards and internal policies.
* Support audits and operational assessments.
* Ensure adherence to: ISO 27001, TIA-942, Uptime Institute standards, Local regulatory requirements, Safety standards

Automation and Continuous Improvement

* Leverage automation tools for operational efficiency.
* Utilize predictive analytics and AI-driven monitoring platforms.
* Implement operational improvements to enhance reliability and efficiency.
* Drive initiatives to optimize PUE and sustainability metrics.
  

**Key skills required:**

* Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Equivalent experience in mission-critical data center environments may be considered.
* 5-10+ years of experience in data center operations, mission-critical facilities, or infrastructure operations.
* Experience supporting AI, HPC, hyperscale, or cloud data center environments preferred.
* Experience with high-density rack deployments and GPU infrastructure is highly desirable.
* Technical skills

Data Center Infrastructure

* Critical Facilities Operations, Electrical Power Systems
* Mechanical Cooling Systems, Rack and Cabling Infrastructure, Environmental Monitoring

AI Data Center Technologies

* GPU Infrastructure, AI and HPC Platforms, High-Density Compute Environments
* Liquid Cooling Technologies, High-Speed Network Fabrics

Monitoring Platforms

* DCIM, BMS, EMS, SCADA, Infrastructure Monitoring Tools

Operations Management

* Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Capacity Planning, Root Cause Analysis

Automation

* PowerShell, Python, Infrastructure Automation Tools, Monitoring Analytics Platforms

title: Medical Typist
description:
**Job Title:** Medical Typist – Radiology Department

**Location:** Ashok Vihar near satyawati college, Delhi

**Department:** Radiology & Imaging

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reports To:** Head of Radiology / Center Administrator

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a fast, accurate, and detail-oriented **Medical Typist** to join our Radiology Department. The ideal candidate will be responsible for transcribing, formatting, and proofreading diagnostic imaging reports (such as X-Ray, Ultrasound, CT Scan, MRI, dictated or drafted by Radiologists. Accuracy, knowledge of medical and radiological terminology, and strict adherence to patient confidentiality are essential for this role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Report Transcription & Typing:** Accurately transcribe and type diagnostic radiology reports from audio dictations, handwritten notes, or digital templates within established turnaround times (TAT).
* **Formatting & Proofreading:** Format reports clearly using standard departmental templates. Review and edit drafts for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and accurate medical/anatomical terminology before submitting them to the Radiologist for final verification and signature.
* **System & Record Management:** Enter, update, and manage patient diagnostic data in the Radiology Information System (RIS), Hospital Information System (HIS), or Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS).
* **Report Dispatch & Coordination:** Print, organize, and coordinate with the front desk/dispatch team to ensure finalized reports and imaging films/CDs are delivered to patients or referring physicians on time.
* **Quality & Confidentiality:** Flag any unclear dictations, discrepancies in patient details (name, age, ID, scan type), or critical/urgent findings to the Radiologist immediately. Maintain strict patient privacy and data security at all times.
* **Administrative Support:** Maintain daily logs of completed reports, manage digital archives, and assist the Radiology team with routine clerical duties as needed.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline (Candidates with a background in Science, Life Sciences, or a Diploma/Certificate in Medical Transcription will be given preference).
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of experience as a Medical Typist or Medical Transcriptionist, preferably in a Radiology/Diagnostic center or hospital setup. *(Freshers with exceptional typing speed and medical terminology knowledge may also apply).*
* **Typing Speed:** Minimum typing speed of **40–50 WPM (Words Per Minute)** with at least **95%+ accuracy**.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong command of MS Word, Excel, and basic computer operations; familiarity with RIS/PACS or diagnostic lab software is a strong advantage.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Solid understanding of human anatomy, radiological procedures, and medical abbreviations.
* **Soft Skills:** High attention to detail, ability to work calmly under pressure during peak patient hours, good listening skills, and strong organizational habits.

**Working Hours & Benefits**

* **Shift Timings:** 9 hours/ Rotational Shifts]
* **Compensation:** Competitive salary based on experience and typing test performance + statutory benefits (PF/ESIC, if applicable).

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Bakery Manager
description:
About Vlicious

Vlicious is a premium cake and bakery brand specialising in designer cakes, customised birthday cakes, luxury wedding cakes and celebration desserts. We offer a wide range of handcrafted creations, with orders received through our website, Zomato and other online platforms.

We operate through a cloud kitchen model rather than a traditional walk-in retail bakery.

We are looking for an experienced and responsible **Bakery Manager** who can independently manage and oversee the complete bakery operations, ensuring smooth production, consistent product quality, efficient team management and timely order fulfilment.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of bakery production, staff supervision, inventory management, quality control and day-to-day kitchen operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Overall Bakery Operations**

* Manage and oversee the complete day-to-day operations of the bakery and production kitchen.
* Ensure smooth functioning of all bakery activities, from order receipt and production planning to packaging and final dispatch.
* Plan daily production schedules based on incoming orders, custom requirements and expected demand.
* Ensure timely completion of orders, especially customised cakes, bulk orders and wedding cake requirements.
* Establish and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for efficient kitchen operations.

**2. Bakery Production & Quality Control**

* Supervise the preparation and production of cakes, pastries, desserts and other bakery products.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, freshness, finishing, presentation and product quality.
* Oversee the production of customised designer cakes, theme cakes, premium celebration cakes and luxury wedding cakes.
* Ensure recipes, measurements, portion sizes and production standards are followed consistently.
* Monitor production timelines and ensure all products meet the required quality standards before dispatch.
* Coordinate with cake artists, decorators, bakers and production staff to ensure customised designs are executed as per client requirements.

**3. Team Management & Supervision**

* Manage, supervise and allocate responsibilities to bakers, pastry chefs, cake decorators, helpers and other kitchen staff.
* Prepare staff schedules, manage attendance and ensure adequate manpower for daily operations.
* Train team members on production processes, quality standards, hygiene and kitchen SOPs.
* Monitor staff productivity, discipline and overall performance.
* Ensure proper coordination and accountability across the production team.

**4. Inventory, Procurement & Cost Control**

* Monitor daily inventory of raw materials, ingredients, packaging materials and other bakery supplies.
* Maintain optimal stock levels and coordinate with vendors and suppliers for timely procurement.
* Monitor consumption, wastage, expiry dates and storage conditions.
* Maintain proper inventory records and follow FIFO/FEFO practices.
* Control production costs and minimise unnecessary wastage.
* Ensure ingredients and raw materials meet the required quality standards.

**5. Online Orders & Dispatch Management**

* Oversee incoming orders received through Zomato, the company website and other online platforms.
* Coordinate order preparation, prioritisation, packaging and timely dispatch.
* Ensure order accuracy, proper labelling, safe packaging and product presentation.
* Coordinate with delivery partners and internal teams to avoid delays or incorrect deliveries.
* Ensure customised and time-sensitive orders are handled according to their delivery schedules.
* Monitor customer complaints related to product quality, order accuracy and delivery coordination, and take corrective action.

**6. Hygiene, Safety & Maintenance**

* Maintain high standards of kitchen cleanliness, food safety and personal hygiene.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI guidelines and food safety practices.
* Monitor proper storage, refrigeration and handling of ingredients and finished products.
* Ensure regular cleaning and maintenance of ovens, mixers, refrigerators, equipment and other kitchen machinery.
* Maintain production records, stock reports, wastage reports and daily operational updates.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in bakery operations, bakery production, pastry kitchen management or food production supervision.
* Strong practical knowledge of bakery operations and commercial cake production.
* Experience managing bakers, pastry chefs, cake decorators and kitchen support staff.
* Understanding of designer cakes, customised cakes, fondant work, cream cakes, premium cakes and wedding cake production will be preferred.
* Experience in managing cloud kitchens, online food orders or delivery-based bakery operations will be an advantage.
* Good understanding of inventory management, procurement, costing and wastage control.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene standards and FSSAI compliance.
* Ability to manage production schedules, multiple orders and strict delivery timelines.
* Strong leadership, organisation, problem-solving and team-management skills.
* Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in Excel or inventory management systems.
* Ability to take independent responsibility for the overall functioning of the bakery.

A qualification or diploma in Bakery & Confectionery, Pastry Arts, Hotel Management or Culinary Arts will be an added advantage.

Preferred Industry Background

Candidates with experience in:

* Premium and Luxury Cake Brands
* Designer Cake Studios
* Commercial Bakeries
* Cloud Kitchen Operations
* Pastry & Confectionery Production
* Hotel Bakery and Pastry Departments
* Online Cake Delivery Brands

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can take complete ownership of the bakery operations and ensure that everything runs efficiently, from production planning and staff management to quality control, inventory and final order dispatch.

The candidate should be hands-on, organised, quality-conscious and capable of managing the bakery independently without requiring constant supervision.

If you have the experience and leadership skills to manage a professional bakery production setup and maintain high standards of quality and efficiency, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

title: Junior Application Administrator
description:
### **Description**

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**

At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower over 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.  
  
**Job Description**  
  
We are looking for a **MuleSoft Developer** to support the development, maintenance, and optimization of integrations using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. In this role, you will maintain APIs, connectors, and integrations across key business systems including Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira, and other third-party applications. You will work closely with technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements, support application deployments, resolve integration issues, and contribute to process improvements. Working within an Agile environment, you will help deliver reliable, scalable integration solutions that support business operations.

  

### **Responsibilities**

  

* Develop, maintain, configure, and support integrations using **MuleSoft Anypoint Platform** and **Mule 4**.
* Maintain MuleSoft APIs, connectors, and integrations across **Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira**, and other external systems.
* Develop, build, deploy, test, and troubleshoot MuleSoft applications.
* Assist with application releases, testing, debugging, and production issue resolution in collaboration with senior team members.
* Develop and maintain integrations using **RESTful and SOAP web services**, XML, JSON, and **DataWeave** transformations.
* Configure and maintain third-party **MuleSoft Anypoint Connectors**.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Participate in business process design and identify opportunities to improve integration workflows.
* Work within an **Agile/Sprint methodology**, contributing to planning, estimation, development, testing, and delivery activities.
* Estimate the level of effort required for system enhancements, configuration changes, and integration improvements.
* Create and maintain clear documentation for integrations, processes, configurations, and policies.
* Support the onboarding and training of local and remote users.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues and ensure integrations remain reliable and effective.

  

### **About You**

  

* **2+ years of experience as a MuleSoft Developer**, including hands-on MuleSoft configuration and integration development.
* Foundational to intermediate understanding of **Mule 4 architecture, components, and integration concepts**.
* Hands-on experience developing, building, deploying, testing, and supporting MuleSoft applications.
* Good knowledge of **RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, XML, JSON, and DataWeave**.
* Experience working with **MuleSoft Anypoint Platform** and third-party Anypoint Connectors.
* Experience gathering and understanding business and technical requirements and translating them into integration solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to estimate development effort and work effectively within Agile sprint cycles.
* Experience creating technical, process, and policy documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to support and train users across local and remote teams.
* **Salesforce configuration and/or NetSuite knowledge is an advantage.**
* **MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 1** certification is preferred.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Health insurance fully paid–Spouse, children, and Parents
* Accident insurance fully paid
* Flexible working allowance
* 25 days holidays
* 7 paid sick days
* 13 public holidays
* Employee Assistance Program

We believe that diversity of experience, perspective, and background leads to a better environment for all our people and a better product for our customers. Everyone is welcome at Eptura, no matter where you are from, and the more diverse we are, the more unified we will be in ensuring respectful connections all around the world.

  

### **About Eptura**

Ready to make a difference? Explore opportunities with Eptura and join us on this incredible journey.  
  
Joining Eptura means becoming part of a forward-thinking, dynamic team that's on a mission to shape a better, more connected future. We're seeking passionate, driven individuals who want to make a real impact and be at the forefront of workplace innovation.

title: Implementation & Training Executive (Healthcare IT) – PurpleIPD
description:
**Implementation & Training Executive (Healthcare IT) – PurpleIPD**

**Company:** PurpleBits Infosystems Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:** Delhi, with PAN India travel

**Experience:** 1–4 years

**Employment type:** Full-time, travel-based role

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month, plus performance incentives

About Us

PurpleBits is a Gujarat-based healthcare IT company with 15 years of experience and 250+ hospitals served across India. Our flagship product, **PurpleIPD**, is an ABDM-certified, tablet-based inpatient documentation system that helps hospitals go paperless, improve documentation quality, and stay compliant with national digital health standards.

The Role

We're looking for an implementation and training executive who can take a hospital from "sale closed" to "fully live and using PurpleIPD". You will travel to client hospitals across India, set up the system, train doctors, nurses, and admin staff, and make sure the hospital actually adopts it.

Key Responsibilities

* **Implementation:** Install, configure, and set up PurpleIPD at client hospitals, including tablets, user accounts, departments, and templates, in coordination with the technical team.
* **Requirement mapping:** Understand each hospital's workflows and documentation formats, and map them to the product.
* **Training:** Train doctors, nursing staff, and administrators through classroom sessions and hands-on bedside or ward-level training.
* **Go-live support:** Be on-site during go-live to resolve issues quickly and build staff confidence.
* **Adoption tracking:** Follow up after go-live to check usage, fix gaps, and ensure staff continue to use the system.
* **Documentation:** Prepare training material, user guides, and implementation reports for each site.
* **Issue escalation:** Log bugs, change requests, and customer feedback and pass them to the product and support teams.
* **Customer relationships:** Be a friendly, reliable face of PurpleBits for the hospital's management and staff.

Must-Have

* 1–4 years of experience in implementation, training, application support, or customer onboarding, ideally for hospital software (HIS/EMR/LIS) or other healthcare products.
* Willingness to **travel PAN India** for extended periods, often at short notice.
* Ready to stay in the hospital for 7-15 days for training.
* Strong communication and presentation skills; fluency in **English and Hindi**.
* Ability to explain technology simply to doctors, nurses, and non-technical staff.
* Patience, a problem-solving attitude, and the ability to stay calm during go-live pressure.
* Comfort using tablets, laptops, and basic troubleshooting (Wi-Fi, devices, apps).

Good to Have

* Understanding of hospital workflows (IPD, nursing, OT, billing, pharmacy).
* Exposure to ABDM or digital health standards.
* Clinical background (nursing, BPharm, BSc, paramedical) or a healthcare administration degree.
* Knowledge of Gujarati or other regional languages.
* Prior experience conducting training sessions.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary of ₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month, based on experience and skills
* Performance-based incentives linked to timely go-lives and successful adoption
* Travel, accommodation, and daily allowances as per company policy

title: Senior Named Account Manager
description:
**About Us:**

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

**Corporate Overview**  
Proofpoint is a leading cybersecurity company protecting organizations’ greatest assets and biggest risks: vulnerabilities in people. With an integrated suite of cloud-based solutions, Proofpoint helps companies around the world stop targeted threats, safeguard their data, and make their users more resilient against cyber-attacks. Leading organizations of all sizes, including more than half of the Fortune 1000, rely on Proofpoint for people-centric security and compliance solutions mitigating their most critical risks across email, the cloud, social media, and the web. We are singularly devoted to helping our customers protect their greatest assets and biggest security risk: their people. That’s why we’re a leader in next-generation cybersecurity.

Protection Starts with People. Proofpoint.

**The Role**

Proofpoint, Inc. is seeking a self-starting highly motivated sales professional to join our successful and growing Named Accounts organization. This team helps large enterprise organizations and protect their most sensitive data. Our new team member will have a proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales goals, and will have extensive experience as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs and other C-level executives.

The Named Account Manager will team up with our world-class Sales Engineering Organization and our channels team to introduce Proofpoint to new customers, as well as to expand our presence with companies who are already part of our existing customer base.

The candidate who will best fit our culture will take great pride in delivering for customers and act with honesty and integrity. They will always operate as part of the team, strive for innovation, take initiative and be accountable, but most importantly, they will be here to win from day one.

**Your day-to-day**

Have the ability to establish strong business relationships at the executive level, advanced solution selling capabilities, conducting sales presentations, coordinating multiple resources within an account, while consistently and successfully closing business for Proofpoint.

Strive to both penetrate net new accounts as well as to expand our presence with existing customers by introducing them to the rest of our security portfolio.

Partner with the channel organization in order to secure new share of the security market.

Team up with our Sales/Systems Engineering team to prepare account strategies and plans, and to deliver outstanding product demos and proof of concept programs to prospects and customers.

Last, but certainly not least, WIN!! Blow your quota out of the water!

**What you bring to the team**

We are looking for an enterprise sales professional with a minimum of 10 years of experience in a field sales role selling to large enterprise organizations.

Ideally we would like to see experience selling Enterprise Security or Information Technology products, but if you’re a “rockstar” from a different industry, we still want to talk to you!

Must have a proven and demonstrable track record of exceeding sales goals

Strong written and verbal communication skills and be able to clearly and effectively articulate Proofpoint’s value.

Great sales people are organized, detail and process oriented.

Must be a self-starter with the ability to work independently or in a team environment.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and use good judgment in resolving difficult issues.

Experience with SalesForce or similar CRM tools strongly preferred

BA/BS or equivalent preferred.

**Why Proofpoint**

Protecting people is at the heart of our award-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer-focused and a driven-to-win organization with leading-edge products. We are an inclusive, diverse, multinational company that believes in culture fit, but more importantly ‘culture-add’, and we strongly encourage people from all walks of life to apply.

We believe in hiring the best and the brightest to help cultivate our culture of collaboration and appreciation. Apply today and explore your future at Proofpoint! #LifeAtPFPT #LI-KT2

**Why Proofpoint?**

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us:

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities

**Our Culture:**

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

**How to Apply**

Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Center Manager
description:

**Location:** Pachouli Wellness Clinic, Vasundhara, Ghaziabad  
**Department:** Clinic Operations  
**Reports To:** Regional Head  
**Working Hours:** 9 Hours per Day  
**Industry:** Aesthetic, Dermatology, Cosmetology, Beauty & Wellness

1. Position Overview

Pachouli Wellness Clinic is looking for a dynamic, target-oriented and experienced Center Manager for its Vasundhara, Ghaziabad center.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall clinic operations, conducting guest consultations and counselling, driving sales conversions, achieving revenue targets and ensuring excellent customer experience.

The ideal candidate must have prior experience in the Aesthetic, Cosmetology, Dermatology, Beauty or Wellness industry, along with strong consultation, counselling, sales and team management skills.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Guest Consultation & Counselling**

* Personally handle guest consultations and understand their requirements.
* Counsel guests regarding skin, hair, laser, slimming, beauty and wellness treatments.
* Explain treatment procedures, benefits, packages and pricing.
* Recommend suitable treatment plans based on guest requirements and doctor's recommendations.
* Handle guest queries, objections and price negotiations effectively.
* Ensure a professional and personalized consultation experience.

**B. Sales & Revenue Management**

* Take complete ownership of the clinic's monthly revenue targets.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Drive package sales, renewals, upselling and cross-selling.
* Convert walk-in guests and prospective leads into paying customers.
* Monitor daily sales, collections and conversion ratios.
* Conduct regular sales reviews and implement strategies to improve conversions.
* Ensure effective follow-ups with prospective and existing guests.

**C. Clinic Operations**

* Manage the complete day-to-day operations of the clinic.
* Ensure proper staff deployment and coordination.
* Monitor appointments, guest footfall and service delivery.
* Maintain clinic hygiene, ambience and grooming standards.
* Ensure smooth coordination between doctors, therapists, counsellors and front office staff.
* Ensure implementation of company SOPs.

**D. Team Management**

* Lead and manage the complete clinic team.
* Allocate responsibilities and targets to team members.
* Monitor individual performance and productivity.
* Conduct daily team meetings and sales reviews.
* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, onboarding, attendance and employee-related matters.
* Maintain team discipline and professional standards.

**E. Customer Relationship Management**

* Handle customer complaints and escalations.
* Ensure guest satisfaction and treatment continuity.
* Monitor follow-ups and customer feedback.
* Drive repeat business, customer retention and referrals.
* Maintain long-term relationships with guests.

**F. Financial, Inventory & Reporting**

* Ensure accurate billing and daily cash reconciliation.
* Monitor collections and prevent revenue leakage.
* Maintain inventory and consumable stock.
* Submit daily sales, collection, footfall and attendance reports.
* Coordinate with Corporate Office for operational and financial requirements.

**3. Qualification & Education**

Candidates must fulfil the following educational criteria:

* Degree/Diploma in Cosmetology or Aesthetic-related fields.
* Qualification in Dermatology, Beauty, Skin & Hair Science or Wellness-related fields.
* Graduate/Postgraduate in Healthcare, Hospitality or Management, preferably with relevant Aesthetic/Wellness industry qualifications or experience.

**Preference will be given to candidates with educational qualifications directly related to the Aesthetic, Cosmetology, Dermatology or Wellness industry.**

4. Required Experience

* Prior experience in the Aesthetic, Dermatology, Cosmetology, Laser, Beauty or Wellness industry is mandatory.
* Experience as a Center Manager, Clinic Manager, Branch Manager, Senior Counsellor or Sales Manager will be preferred.
* Hands-on experience in guest consultation, treatment counselling and package selling is essential.
* Proven track record of achieving sales and revenue targets.
* Experience in managing clinic teams and day-to-day operations.

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent guest consultation and counselling skills.
* Strong sales conversion and negotiation skills.
* Revenue and target-oriented approach.
* Knowledge of aesthetic, skin, hair, laser and wellness treatments.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Billing, reporting and operational management.
* Professional grooming and customer-handling etiquette.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of 100% assigned monthly revenue targets.
* Strong guest consultation-to-sales conversion.
* Achievement of package sales and renewal targets.
* Improvement in customer retention and repeat business.
* Effective management of daily clinic operations.
* Maintenance of customer satisfaction standards.
* Proper team productivity and discipline.
* 100% timely submission of daily and monthly reports.
* Compliance with company SOPs and operational guidelines.

7. Working Conditions

* **Location:** Vasundhara, Ghaziabad, Pachouli Wellness Clinic.
* **Shift Duration:** 9 Hours per Day.
* **Working Days:** As per company policy.
* **Role Type:** Full-Time.
* **Reporting:** Regional Head / Operations Head.

8. Overall Role Expectation

The Center Manager must function as the overall business owner of the assigned clinic, personally drive guest consultations and counselling, convert business opportunities into sales, achieve monthly revenue targets and ensure smooth clinic operations while maintaining Pachouli's service and brand standards.

A hands-on IT professional who can independently manage day-to-day IT operations, support employees across departments, maintain network and server reliability, safeguard company data, coordinate with external vendors, and minimize IT downtime.

title: AI Video Editor (VSL Focus)
description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout** is looking for a **Direct Response Video Editor** to join our team! As our video editor, you will be responsible for editing, producing, and managing multiple creative projects with a heavy focus on paid ad creatives for Meta Platforms - VSLs, short and long form. You'll take raw UGC and transform it into high-converting direct response ads that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience editing paid ads, understands direct response principles, runs a current AI stack in production, and delivers volume and quality in the same week without being chased.

**Who are we?**

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space — $22M+ in revenue and targeting $45-50M in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands-on and active, all while having a **generous performance bonus structure** — then you've come to the right place.

**Key Objectives**

* Consistent output of **8 ad briefs per week,** maintaining volume and quality simultaneously.
* Increase your performance bonus by analyzing prior video metrics to increase views and conversions.
* Apply direct-response copywriting principles to review scripts.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your daily workload efficiently to meet deadlines without needing hand-holding or frequent check-ins.
* Quickly learn and master new tools and software, and editing techniques as social media trends evolve, often with less than a day's notice.
* Ensure every video meets our exacting quality standards and perfectly matches the provided instructions, minimizing the need for revisions.
* Maintain clear, proactive communication with the company founders and executive team, providing updates when necessary.
* Create ad variations and iterations to scale winning ads and improve performance.
* Collaborate with the creative strategy team to bring ad concepts to life.
* Apply direct response marketing principles to editing (hooks, problem/solution flow, testimonials, CTAs).
* Stay up to date on internet trends and editing styles to ensure our ads feel native and engaging.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote.
* Fluent in English.
* Proven experience creating short-form direct-response videos for DTC brands.
* Proven experience with professional video-editing software is required. We have a strong preference for Adobe Premiere Pro
* Paid Ad Focus: Proven experience editing Meta/Facebook paid ads that convert.
* Volume: Comfortable producing **8 ad briefs per week.**
* Tools: Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
* Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to combine storytelling with data-driven feedback to refine and improve ads.
* No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You're passionate about your work and excited by the idea of producing ads that millions will see.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
* **Deep DTC Experience**: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories.
* Meta VSLs: Proven experience with short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run.
* **AI Stack**: You run a current AI stack in production, not one you tried once.
* Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.

**KPI'S you will own**

* **8 ad briefs per week** Quota
* 80% First-Pass Approval Rate: At least 80% of submissions require no revisions.

**Accountabilities**

* Deliver 8 ad briefs per week
* Edit VSLs and DR video ads with AI-first workflows
* Weekly iterations on top-performing ads to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure ads are visually compelling, on-brand, and optimized for performance.
* Stay plugged into social media/UGC trends to keep our creatives fresh and competitive.
* Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns by testing different edits, structures, and hooks.
* Work fluently across AI video and UGC tools (Higgsfield, and similar)
* Collaborate closely with strategists, copywriters, and performance teams

**This Role Is Not For You If**

* You are a meticulous video perfectionist who will spend hours refining a single transition or effect. With a high daily quota, success in this role demands efficiency. Adhering perfectly to the video template at speed is valued over spending extra time on minor details that don't contribute to views or conversions.
* You thrive in highly collaborative, team-oriented environments with frequent meetings and brainstorming sessions. This is a high-autonomy, "heads-down" role where you will be working independently the majority of the time to meet your individual production goals.
* You are a methodical planner who prefers stable, long-term projects and predictable workflows. Our environment is inherently dynamic. The tools, guidelines, and video styles can change overnight, and you must be able to pivot instantly without frustration.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

We review applications on a rolling basis. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens up, exceptional candidates may be hired immediately.
  
Our process has three stages:  
(1) Application Review + Screening - we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit.
  
(2) Technical Interview + Creative Brief - a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work.
  
(3) Culture Fit Interview - a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us.
  
KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.

For this role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business — and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed.

**Salary Expectation**

USD $1,000 - $1,500 per month (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.

**We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta only.**

description:
**About Square Aesthetic & Wellness Clinic**

Square Aesthetic & Wellness Clinic is a premium-grade aesthetic and dermatology clinic focused on advanced, personalized solutions for skin, hair, and aesthetic wellness.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a full-time Aesthetic Dermatologist to join our clinical team. The role involves evaluating patient concerns, developing personalized treatment plans, recommending appropriate aesthetic solutions, and performing a range of procedures with precision, safety, and attention to detail. The ideal candidate is confident, patient-focused, clinically responsible, and passionate about building a career in aesthetic medicine.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct daily OPD consultations for walk-in and scheduled patients.

* Develop long-term relationships with patients through professional and personalized care.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain treatments and procedures clearly and confidently to patients.
* Professional approach with strong ethical and hygiene standards.
* Ability to work efficiently in a high-volume OPD environment.
* Passion for aesthetics, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional patient care.

description:

What you will work on

* Write short video/Reel scripts, opening hooks, on-screen text and clear calls to action.

* Develop ad-copy variations, headlines, landing-page copy and social captions for different audiences and offers.

* Write and edit SEO articles, introductions, page copy, titles, meta descriptions and heading outlines that match search intent.

* Research a topic, check facts, work from approved product information and avoid unsupported claims.

What we are looking for

* Clear English writing, sound grammar, editing ability and attention to detail.

* Availability for an in-office internship in Wazirpur/Shalimar Bagh, Delhi. Share your current locality, commute/relocation plan and college or other scheduling commitments.

How to apply

Share your CV and two or three writing samples, ideally one SEO article/page and one ad or script. Personal or college samples are welcome. For each, explain the audience, objective and your own contribution. Use public or view-access links and do not share confidential client work. If you have no portfolio, you may submit a short self-created sample and label it clearly.

Also tell us your current city/locality, full-time office availability, expected monthly stipend, earliest joining date and internship availability/duration. We will discuss duration and work schedule during screening; no conversion to a permanent role is promised.

Portfolio review, a 45–60-minute fictional writing exercise and a brief live discussion/rewrite. The exercise tests ad/script writing, SEO content, editing, factual accuracy and reasoning. title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Specialist
description:
**About GRI**

GRI is the independent global standard setter for sustainability impact reporting. GRI provides the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards and works with businesses, regulators, investors, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders to advance transparency, accountability, and sustainable development.

Through a multi-stakeholder process, GRI develops standards that reflect global best practice and public interest. With staff in more than 20 countries, we combine global perspective with local relevance, supporting long-term value creation for organizations and society.

**About the role**

The Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Consultant designs, develops and supports CRM solutions that enable GRI teams to work effectively with business and customer information.
  
  
The role translates business needs into scalable Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure-based solutions and contributes to the continuous improvement of GRI's digital capabilities. Working closely with business stakeholders and the IT team in the Netherlands, the role delivers reliable solutions, resolves production issues and supports users across the organization.

**Responsibilities**

***Delivery***

* Design, develop, customize and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions that meet agreed business requirements and support effective business processes.
* Configure and customize Dynamics 365 entities, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, process flows, security roles and related solutions.
* Develop and maintain custom CRM functionality and integrations using C#, .NET, REST APIs and Microsoft Azure integration services.
* Develop and improve Power Platform solutions that streamline business processes and improve user productivity.
* Troubleshoot production issues, analyze root causes and implement sustainable solutions that maintain the reliability of CRM services.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and maintain clear technical, solution and support documentation.
* Deliver user and administrator training and knowledge transfer within organization to support effective adoption and ongoing use of CRM solutions.

***Engagement***

* Engage with business stakeholders to understand requirements, explain technical options and translate business needs into workable CRM solutions.
* Collaborate with the IT team in the Netherlands and support global business users, sharing knowledge and providing clear guidance on solutions, changes and support.
* Work with relevant internal and external stakeholders when integrating Dynamics 365 with other business systems.

**Requirements**

***Work experience***

* Experience developing and supporting solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Platform, with approximately 5 years of overall IT experience, including at least 3 years in CRM.
* Experience configuring and customizing Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, including Dataverse, security, solution management, plugins, workflows and custom development.
* Experience integrating Dynamics 365 CRM with external applications using RESTful services, APIs and Microsoft integration technologies.
* Experience working with Microsoft Azure services for enterprise application integration, including Logic Apps, Functions, Key Vault, App Services or WebJobs.
* Experience with software development using C#, .NET/.NET Framework, ASP.NET, REST/Web APIs, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and JSON.
* Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL queries, stored procedures, data modelling and performance optimization.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, source control, CI/CD concepts, testing and Agile software development.

***Knowledge and abilities***

* Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and its configuration, customization and development capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Model-Driven Apps, Canvas Apps and Power Pages; Power BI experience is an advantage.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Azure services used for application integration, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions and Azure Key Vault.
* Ability to analyze business requirements, identify practical technical solutions and explain technical information clearly to business stakeholders.
* Ability to troubleshoot issues, investigate root causes and implement sustainable improvements.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to create technical documentation and deliver user and administrator training.

**What we offer**

* Location: Remote form India. Candidates must have an existing right to work from India.
* Work hours: Full-time (40hrs/week)
* Contract type: 1 year, with possibility for extension
* Salary: INR 1.075.200 - 1.263.360 gross per year
* Start date: as soon as possible
* Generous leave allowance
* Access to the GRI Academy

The application deadline for this position is Monday 26 October 2026 at 12:00 (noon) CEST. Applications received after this date will not be considered.

We aim to create a recruitment process that champions diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring all candidates have equal opportunities and are evaluated based on their unique skills and experiences. If you need any support or adjustments during the application process, please reach out to us.

title: Clinical Administrator - Dentist (0-2 years)
description:
**Clinic Manager (BDS) — Non-Clinical Dental Role - Front Office & Patient Experience · Reporting Directly to the Founders**

**This is a NON-CLINICAL job for a dentist.** No chairside procedure. If you hold a **BDS** and you're more excited by running a world-class clinic than by drilling teeth all day — this role was written for you.

Build the business side of dentistry

**Dr. Sobti's Dental Care** is a premium, implant-focused dental clinic in **Rajouri Garden, West Delhi**, run since 2009 by founders **Dr. Pushkar Sobti** and **Dr. Parul Sharma Sobti**. We're known for full-arch and All-on-X implant work, an in-house digital lab, CBCT and intraoral scanning, and an attached dental academy.

We're hiring a **BDS graduate who wants to grow into clinic management** — not to treat patients, but to help run the practice: the front desk, patient experience, coordination, and day-to-day administration. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders and learn how a high-end dental business actually operates.

The role at a glance

**Position**

Clinic Administrator / Front Desk Executive (BDS)

**Nature of role**

100% non-clinical — administration & patient experience

**Reports to**

Founders directly — Dr. Parul Sharma Sobti & Dr. Pushkar Sobti

**Qualification**

BDS (mandatory)

**Experience**

Fresher, or up to 2 years of dental experience

**Location**

Rajouri Garden, West Delhi

**Timings**  
9:00 am to 8 pm

**Working days**  
Clinic is open 7 days a week. Weekly off day will be decided during the interview.

**Growth track**

Front Desk → Clinic Manager → Operations leadership

Why a BDS should want this job

Most dentists finish BDS and face two tiring paths: years of underpaid clinical practice, or an expensive MDS. There's a third path most never hear about — **the business of dentistry** — and it's where the real long-term money and leadership sit.

* **No clinical burnout.** Your BDS becomes your superpower, not your ceiling. You understand treatments, patients, and dentists — now you'll learn to run the system around them.
* **Learn directly from the founders.** You report to Dr. Parul and Dr. Pushkar personally. This is mentorship in clinic operations, patient conversion, and premium-practice management you can't buy in a course.
* **A real growth ladder.** Start at the front desk, grow into Clinic Manager, then into operations leadership as we expand across Delhi NCR.
* **Premium brand, premium patients.** You represent one of West Delhi's most respected implant practices — high-value cases, sophisticated patients, a polished environment.
* **Earn from performance.** Beyond a fixed salary, your growth is tied to incentives — the better the clinic runs and converts, the more you make.
* **Future-proof skill set.** Clinic management, patient experience, and operations are transferable across every healthcare business you may ever run or own.

What you'll own

* Be the face of the clinic — greet, guide, and manage the experience of every patient from walk-in to follow-up.
* Manage appointments, scheduling, and the daily patient flow so the clinic runs smoothly.
* Handle patient enquiries, calls, and messages, and coordinate between patients and the clinical team.
* Explain treatment plans, estimates, and next steps to patients in simple language (your BDS makes this effortless).
* Support patient conversion — help interested patients move confidently from consultation to treatment.
* Maintain records, reports, and front-office documentation accurately.
* Coordinate with the clinical, lab, and admin teams to keep operations tight.
* Uphold the premium standards, cleanliness, and warmth our patients expect.

Who we're looking for

* **BDS graduate** — fresher, or up to 2 years of dental experience.
* Genuinely more interested in **clinic management and the business of dentistry** than in clinical practice.
* Warm, well-spoken, and presentable — comfortable being the first impression of a premium clinic.
* Strong communication in **English and Hindi**; confident on calls and in person.
* Organized, reliable, and quick to learn systems and software.
* Comfortable with computers, scheduling tools, and basic reporting.
* Hungry to grow, take ownership, and build a long-term career with us.

*No prior admin experience required — the right attitude and a BDS matter most. We'll train you.*

What we offer

* **Competitive fixed salary** plus **performance incentives** — your earnings grow as you do.
* **Direct mentorship** from the founders in clinic management and premium-practice operations.
* A **clear promotion path** into Clinic Manager and operations leadership.
* Hands-on exposure to a modern digital clinic — implants, All-on-X, in-house lab, and an academy.
* A respected, premium brand to build your career and reputation on.
* A supportive, professional team and a polished work environment.
* The rare chance to grow with a practice that's **expanding across Delhi NCR**.

How to apply

Are you a BDS who'd rather **build and run** a great dental clinic than treat patients all day? We want to meet you.

**Apply directly through Indeed** with your updated CV. In a short note (2–3 lines), tell us why clinic management excites you more than clinical practice.

Shortlisted candidates will meet the founders, Dr. Parul and Dr. Pushkar, in person.

description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  
  

**WHAT MAKES US GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

**Job Summary**

The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.

  
  

**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**

**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required
* Independently makes complex manual updates based on incoming requests, applying sound judgment to optimize the product
* Runs periodic user surveys and forums to track satisfaction and identify areas for improvement
* Tracks and analyzes key metrics — including dashboards, usage, and adoption — summarizing insights and findings for stakeholders
* Tests routine updates and enhancements to validate functionality and ensure a user-friendly experience

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

* Elicits requirements on small-to-medium sized requests, working with users to translate use cases and pain points into underlying requirements and potential solutions
* Transforms these requests into actionable work via user stories, process flow diagrams, and other supporting documentation
* Works with appropriate technical teams and third parties to complete these items, prioritizing and communicating dependencies and tradeoffs with key stakeholders throughout

**Develop Domain Knowledge (10%)**

* Builds domain knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of relevant tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Databricks or similar enterprise data platforms) to act more independently
* Stays up to date about emerging analytics technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve ways of working

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking
* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

  

**Experience**

* Experience supporting technology products, analytics platforms, or business systems, ideally in a product management, product operations, business analyst, or similar role. Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise data platforms is preferred
* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs
* Experience working in a corporate environment
* Experience solving basic issues in software tools and turning findings into actionable next steps
* Experience supporting users or customers with clear and helpful communication.
* Experience with support platforms like ServiceNow is preferred

title: Conversion UX Strategist
description:
Indeed Job Title

**Conversion UX Strategist – Landing Page Strategy & CRO**

Job Description

We are looking for a strategic thinker who can understand a client’s business, audience, product or service, and campaign objectives, then independently develop a complete landing-page strategy focused on conversions.

This is **not a website design or development role**. The primary responsibility is research, conversion planning, content structure, messaging strategy, and presenting a clear plan for client approval before design begins.

You should be able to start with a business objective and build the landing-page journey from scratch—without relying on a ready-made layout, predefined section list, or design reference.

What You’ll Do

**1. Business & Audience Research**

* Understand the client’s business model, products or services, target audience, and campaign objectives.
* Research competitors, customer intent, audience pain points, and reasons prospects may hesitate to convert.
* Identify the key information and value propositions needed to persuade the intended audience.
* Translate business goals into a clear landing-page conversion strategy.

**2. Landing-Page Journey Planning**

* Plan the complete visitor journey, from the first screen to the final call to action.
* Decide the appropriate section structure and information hierarchy based on the campaign goal.
* Determine what visitors need to understand, believe, and see before taking action.
* Define the messaging flow, CTA placement, trust elements, and supporting information.
* Develop the page structure independently rather than waiting for a predefined layout or section list.

**3. Content Strategy & Information Gathering**

* Define the purpose and required content of every section.
* Identify missing business information, proof points, case studies, testimonials, and other assets needed to build a persuasive page.
* Prepare focused questions for clients to gather the information required for the strategy.
* Recommend messaging directions that communicate the client’s value clearly and address customer objections.

**4. Conversion Strategy & Decision-Making**

* Explain the reasoning behind each recommended section and its placement.
* Ensure that the page structure supports the campaign objective and intended conversion action.
* Identify potential friction points that could prevent visitors from enquiring or taking the desired action.
* Recommend relevant trust signals, credibility elements, and calls to action based on audience needs.
* Make strategic decisions independently and justify them using customer intent and conversion principles.

**5. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval**

* Prepare a structured Google Doc for client review and approval before design begins.
* Document the business context, campaign objective, target audience, and primary conversion goal.
* Outline the recommended page journey and section-by-section structure.
* Explain the purpose, content requirements, and information hierarchy of each section.
* Document messaging direction, CTA strategy, trust elements, and credibility requirements.
* List missing information and questions that need client input.
* Present the reasoning behind the overall page strategy in clear, professional language.
* Incorporate client feedback and finalize the plan for approval.

**6. Design Handoff**

* Hand over the approved strategy document for page creation using AI design tools.
* Ensure the resulting page follows the approved structure, messaging direction, and conversion objectives.
* Collaborate with the design or delivery team to clarify strategic decisions when needed.

Role Requirements

* Strong research, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving.
* Ability to turn business goals and customer insights into a persuasive page journey.
* Clear writing and content-structuring skills.
* Confidence in explaining and defending strategic recommendations.
* Ability to identify missing information and ask clients the right questions.
* Comfort working independently without ready-made templates or detailed instructions.

Experience

Experience in landing-page strategy, conversion rate optimization (CRO), UX strategy, copywriting, digital marketing strategy, or related work is preferred. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how they approach a business problem and develop a conversion-focused page structure from scratch.

Who Can Apply

* Candidates with experience in UX strategy, CRO, landing-page planning, or conversion-focused copywriting.
* Digital marketing strategists who understand campaign goals, audience intent, and lead generation.
* Strong researchers and writers who can independently structure information and build a persuasive customer journey.
* Candidates who can present strategic recommendations clearly to clients.

Skills

* Business and audience research.
* Landing-page journey planning and information architecture.
* Conversion rate optimization principles.
* Content strategy and messaging hierarchy.
* CTA planning and objection handling.
* Trust-building and credibility strategy.
* Competitor and customer-intent analysis.
* Client communication and presentation.
* Structured documentation using Google Docs.
* Critical thinking, independent decision-making, and clear written communication.

**Important:** This role is about deciding what the landing page should communicate, how it should be structured, and why each section matters. Design skills alone are not sufficient; the ability to develop and explain a conversion strategy independently is essential.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Placement Manager** to manage placement activities for candidates trained under **DDU-GKY 2.0 and various Skill Development Programs**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with employers, identifying suitable job opportunities, organizing recruitment drives and interviews, and ensuring successful placement of trained candidates in relevant industries and job roles.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the **skill development and placement ecosystem**, excellent employer networking skills, and a proven ability to achieve placement targets.

* Collect and understand employer manpower requirements and coordinate recruitment accordingly.
* Organize **job fairs, recruitment drives, walk-in interviews, campus interviews and employer selection processes**.
* Coordinate candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, documentation and joining formalities.
* Ensure maximum conversion of trained candidates into **successful placements and joining**.
* Maintain regular communication with placed candidates and employers for joining and retention tracking.
* Track placement data, joining status, salary details, employer details and candidate retention.
* Prepare MIS reports, placement reports and project-related documentation within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with Training Centre, Mobilization, MIS and Project teams to achieve overall project placement targets.
* Ensure placement activities are aligned with **DDU-GKY and applicable Skill Development Project guidelines/SOPs**.
* Conduct regular market research to identify new employment sectors, job roles and salary opportunities.
* Build a strong employer database and continuously expand the placement network.
* Support the organization in achieving project-wise placement, joining and retention targets.
* Handle employer and candidate grievances related to the placement process.

Required Skills

* Strong **Employer Relationship Management** skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong networking and business development abilities.
* Good knowledge of **placement processes and recruitment practices**.
* Understanding of **DDU-GKY / Skill Development / Government-funded skilling projects**.
* Ability to generate new placement opportunities and employer tie-ups.
* Strong follow-up and target-oriented approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Email and MIS reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and placement targets simultaneously.
* Strong team management and coordination skills.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* DDU-GKY / DDU-GKY 2.0 Projects
* Skill Development Projects
* Government Skill Development Programs
* Placement-linked training projects
* Training & Placement organizations
* NSDC / State Skill Mission / PMKVY-related projects
* Recruitment / Staffing / Manpower Industry
* Corporate HR / Employer Relations
* Job Fairs and Campus Recruitment

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of employer tie-ups generated
* Number of job opportunities generated
* Candidate interview and selection ratio
* Placement and joining percentage
* Average salary offered to candidates
* Candidate retention/continuation after joining
* Employer satisfaction
* Timely and accurate MIS/project reporting
* Achievement of project-wise placement targets

Education

**Bachelor's Degree** in any discipline is required.

MBA/PGDM in HR, Marketing, Business Development or a related field will be an added advantage.

**₹25,000 – ₹50,000 per month**, depending on experience, skills and project requirements.

**Performance-based incentives** may be provided for achieving placement and employer engagement targets.

We are looking for a **target-oriented, proactive and well-connected placement professional** who can independently develop employer networks and convert trained candidates into meaningful employment opportunities.

Candidates with strong experience in **DDU-GKY, Skill Development Projects, Placement Management and Employer Tie-ups** will be given preference.
